label: Triage
blurb: Reads the task, then becomes the leanest harness that can finish it.
_note: A harness that reconfigures itself on the first turn instead of being chosen by a human.

Boots with the UNION of the four pi harnesses' tools, then narrows. Measured 2026-08-10: setActiveTools() inside before_agent_start affects the CURRENT turn — booting with read,bash,edit,write and narrowing to read cost 3,963 tokens, byte-identical to booting with --tools read. So the union costs nothing once triage has decided.

engine is pi, not omp, on purpose. omp's floor is 8,101 tokens even with --no-tools, which is above every pi harness's full price — a triage that ran on omp could never reach the cheap end it exists to reach. The two omp-only harnesses (web, omp) are served by the `delegate` tool instead, which runs them as a one-shot subprocess at their price, once, rather than making every session pay omp's floor.

`delegate` MUST be listed here even though it is registered by the extension, not built in. pi's --tools allowlists extension tools too, so a tool missing from this list cannot be activated later: setActiveTools() accepted it silently and the model got 'Tool delegate not found', fell back to bash, and — with bash also narrowed away — ended up calling `ask` and blocking for its 4h timeout.
No SYSTEM.md of its own beyond the routing note: the chosen harness's SYSTEM.md is appended at runtime, and a second resident persona would fight it.
